the development of 177Lu radiolabelled estradiol-DOTAC conjugate as a potential radiotherapeutic agent.
the synthesis and radiolabelling studies of a steroid conjugated with a macrocyclic chelating agent.
the preparation of an estradiol-congenor with the potential to be radiolabelled with 177Lu for targeted therapy.
